t: Local AI In The App Development Loop
s: This article explores integrating local AI into the app development loop, focusing on tools like Cursor AI, the synergy of HTMX and WebSockets, context-aware chat, and single-file application architectures for accelerated development and future-proof LLM-oriented applications.
sub: Leveraging Cursor AI for code generation, documentation, and cleanup.
Utilizing HTMX and WebSockets for reactive, future-proof web development.
Implementing context-aware chat with conversation history management.
Single-file applications (SPA) for reduced cognitive overhead and AI efficiency.
Designing LLM-oriented apps by capturing user interactions and API chatter for continuous learning and adaptability.
